capabilities: Run a stopwatch from a sidebar panel
Insert the current stopwatch value into the editor with a hotkey
Set a custom start value when the stopwatch was not started in time
Configure printed time format, trimming, color and line break
Persist the stopwatch value in the workspace across app restarts
disambiguation: Not a project or task time tracker; it is a single stopwatch whose value you stamp into notes.
extras: The README's clone-of sentence is cut off before naming the original plugin. Development has moved to Codeberg; the GitHub repository is only a release mirror, and issues should be filed there.
intentEvidence: The stopwatch functionality is a completely rewritten clone of
problem: Obsidian has no built-in stopwatch for marking the exact moment a note was written.
summary: Stopwatch that runs in the sidebar and inserts its current elapsed value into the editor via a hotkey.
